api.py.reason: Spools a DataFrame to a throwaway parquet temp file for the engine to read; never replaced onto a target, so the atomic-write rules do not apply.

ci/debug.py.reason: decoy ci debug log flush; own temp-file recipe, moves onto write_atomic when next touched.

cli/ci.py.reason: decoy ci output writer; own temp-file recipe, moves onto write_atomic when next touched.

cli/run.py.reason: _commit_vault keeps a hard-link backup and restores or removes the vault when the directory fsync fails (tests/e2e/test_vault_commit_order.py); a transaction, not a plain atomic write. L5a moves it to _vault_commit.py and renames this entry.

distribution/first_install.py.reason: Moves the unpacked bundle into place on first install; not a file write.

distribution/installer.py.reason: Swaps whole runtime directories and the launcher shim under the install lock; a different operation from writing one file.

distribution/layout.py.reason: Flips the current-version symlink under the install lock; not a file write.
